name: Etapp 4: BLT Árasluoktastugorna - BLT Stáloluoktastugan

distanceKm.confidence: high for 10 km official display; medium-high for approximately 10.1 km geometry

fieldReports: Reports generally describe the stage as short but rolling, with sustained climb/descent depending on direction.
Older and reverse-direction reports mention rocky or uneven footing and wet/boardwalk sections that can slow progress.

difficulty.label: short scenic mountain-heath stage; not officially graded
officialClaims: STF describes the stage as fine and easy mountain heath.
Naturkartan says the surface is easy-walked, but wet in places with boardwalks.
Field reports caution that the stage is rolling rather than flat and can feel slower with a loaded pack.
keyHazards: Suspension bridge over Árasjåhkå shortly after Árasluokta.
Climb around Stuor Dijdder and repeated smaller rises before the descent toward Stáloluokta.
Wet ground and boardwalks can be slippery in rain.
Open/exposed terrain and poor mobile coverage.
Reindeer fences and Stáloluokta/Árasluokta Sámi settlement areas require extra care and respect.

camping: Naturkartan says there are good tent pitches by the lakes in Dijddervágge, but exact coordinates are not provided.
BLT hut camps support tent-camper service fees; exact tent-area coordinates require verification, especially at Stáloluokta.
Laponia guidance says avoid camping/resting near private huts, goahtes, paths, and reindeer enclosures; use durable or already-used sites.
fire: Fires are regulated by national-park/Laponia rules and any active county/municipal fire ban.
Laponia allows only loose sticks/branches on the ground and prohibits damaging or taking vegetation; a stove-first message is safer for import copy.
Recheck Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten, Krisinformation, and Brandrisk Ute before publication/use.

protectedAreas: Stage 4 lies inside Padjelanta/Badjelánnda National Park and Laponia World Heritage in Jokkmokk municipality, Norrbotten.
Árasluokta and Stáloluokta are Sámi settlement/cabin areas; Stáloluokta is associated with Tuorpon Sámi community summer land.

dogs.rule: Dogs are prohibited in Padjelanta/Badjelánnda except leashed dogs from 1 January to 30 April; normal summer hiking with dogs is not allowed, even leashed.

dronesAircraft.rule: Drones are prohibited without Länsstyrelsen permission; the formal rules also restrict low flying and aircraft start/landing without approval.

reindeerHerding.rule: Do not disturb reindeer, herding, fences, enclosures, or gathering/moving work; stop/sit or detour if needed and do not split herds.
sectionSpecificNotes: Naturkartan says the stage passes a reindeer fence after Árasjåhkå.
The route approaches Stáloluokta, a Tuorpon Sámi summer settlement.
Spring calving and July calf-marking context can affect sensitivity.

fishing.rule: Fishing is restricted in the national park and requires current permit/rule checks. The 2026 Jokkmokkskort brochure indicates a Padjelantaleden corridor exception within 1 km of the trail with limits, but this must be checked before user-facing import.
fishing.importNote: Do not expose fishing as generally allowed without permit and water-specific caveats.

hunting.rule: Hunting is prohibited for ordinary visitors in the national park.

notes: Stage 4 begins by crossing the Árasjåhkå suspension bridge and uses wet/boardwalk sections later.
No stage-specific difficult ford, closure, or reroute was found on 2026-04-29.

Laponia current-info bridge notes about Miellädno near Álggajávrre/Alkavare and seasonal bridges such as Bållávrjåhkå/Varvvek appear off this section, but bridge/currentness pages should be rechecked before import.
Late June can still involve snow, wet ground, high meltwater, and spring-flood conditions.
Assume no mobile coverage along the Padjelantaleden interior; BLT FAQ says Ritsem, Änonjalme, Vaisaluokta and Kvikkjokk have coverage, but the trail itself does not.
BLT/Naturkartan say each cabin camp has an emergency phone in the open/year-round cabin.
Stáloluokta has an OSM emergency-phone candidate; Árasluokta does not yet have a standalone phone coordinate.
